sloka: ततो रंभः तु अनुप्राप्तः तरुण आदित्य संनिभः ।आयुतेन वृतः चैव सहस्रेण शतेन च ॥४-३९-३३॥
transliteration: tato raṁbhaḥ tu anuprāptaḥ taruṇa āditya saṁnibhaḥ ।āyutena vṛtaḥ caiva sahasreṇa śatena ca ॥4-39-33॥

translations.english: Thereafter Rambha of the colour of the rising Sun brought together an army of one thousand and one hundred ayuta troops.
